drivers.note: Each part's range is its own; the parts' ranges don't add up to the total's.

projection.caveat: Faster ice-sheet loss could push this higher, outside this range.

real.rule: We call a change clear when that chance is under 5 in 100 and the whole 95% range is on one side of zero.

caveats: Tide gauge MUMBAI (BOMBAY) (PSMSL id 43), 4 km from the point you asked about.

meaning.headline: Sea level here has clearly been rising.
meaning.limit: This is what tide gauges have already measured. It cannot tell you how high the sea will get.

guidance.fact: Rising about 0.75 mm a year (1878 to 2010; 95% range +0.65 to +0.85 mm a year).
guidance.disclaimer: This shows past measurements and IPCC projections, which depend on how much the world emits. It is not a prediction and not professional advice.
